I recently stayed at Hotel City Premier, Gurgaon, and the experience was really good. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was polite, supportive, and made the stay feel calm and safe.

A special thanks to Tarun for his kindness and helpful attitude he was very courteous and ensured everything was smooth and comfortable during my stay. His positive approach truly made a difference.

The location is convenient, making it easy to travel around Gurgaon. Overall, it was a pleasant and hassle free experience. I would definitely recommend this hotel for a comfortable stay. 🌻

One of the best budget hotels offering premium facilities. The staff and workers are very supportive, helpful, and polite, which makes the stay comfortable and pleasant. The location is good and easily accessible, especially considering the budget.
The rooms are clean and well-maintained, with continuous hot water available. The management is professional and cooperative, and the overall atmosphere gives very positive vibes.
A nice touch is the complimentary welcome drink with coffee and tea. The reception and entry area are clean, relaxing, and have a pleasant fragrance, creating a great first impression.
Overall, excellent value for money. Highly recommended for a comfortable and peaceful stay.
